title: Gina, gwada da kare dashboard mai shi zai iya amincewa

say: Gina, gwada da kare dashboard mai shi zai iya amincewa.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module biyu na Advanced Excel da Dashboards.
Yawancin dashboards ana ciyar da su ta hanyar fitarwa daga tsarin POS, banki ko software na lissafi. Tsaftace su da hannu kowane wata yana jinkirin, kuma anan ne kurakurai ke shiga.

say: Ƙirƙiri yankin Dubawa. Kowane cak yana kwatanta lambobi biyu waɗanda dole ne su yarda, kuma bambancin ya zama 0.
Majiya mai tushe ta Ada ta kai naira miliyan 18,912,500, amma dashboard din ya nuna 18,600,000.
Tazarar ita ce 312,500. Pivot ya yi nuni zuwa ƙayyadaddun kewayon, don haka an bar 5 marigayi daftari na 62,500 kowannensu. Ta nuna pivot a tblSales, refreshes, kuma cak ɗin ya dawo 0.
Ƙara ingantaccen bayanai zuwa sel shigarwa, buɗe waɗancan sel kawai, sannan kare takardar. Gwada cewa masu yankan har yanzu suna aiki. Amma kariyar takarda tana hana haɗari ne kawai.

panel.heading: Kariya ba tsaro ba ne
right: Yana kiyaye bayanan sirri na sirri
Don albashi, abokan ciniki, bayanan banki

say: Don albashi, bayanan abokin ciniki ko bayanin banki, yi amfani da Encrypt tare da Kalmar wucewa, tare da kalmar sirri mai ƙarfi da aka aika ta wata tashar daban.
Fitarwa sau da yawa yana riƙe sunayen abokin ciniki da lambobin waya. Cire ginshiƙan da ba ku buƙata, kuma kada ku taɓa tura fitar da ɗanyen fitarwa akan WhatsApp na sirri.

panel.heading: Kariya ba tsaro ba ne
right: Yana kiyaye bayanan sirri na sirri
Don albashi, abokan ciniki, bayanan banki

say: Kafin aika fayil ɗin, yi alama kowane abu. Gwaji da bayanai masu banƙyama bisa manufa: adadi mara kyau, kwanan wata da aka buga azaman rubutu, daftari kwafi.
Kar a boye kurakurai tare da IFERROR da sifili, saboda karyewar binciken sai yayi kama da sifili na gaske.
A ƙarshe, rubuta takardar yadda take aiki kuma ka nemi wani ya bi ta ba tare da taimakonka ba.

say: Yi atomatik shigo da kaya daga babban fayil na aƙalla fayiloli uku. Gina dashboard ɗin allo ɗaya tare da katunan, jadawali da yanki mai alaƙa. Sa'an nan ƙara rajistan ƙwayoyin cuta, kare shi kuma rubuta takardar yadda yake aiki.
Yanzu ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
